description: This source file defines an enum class 'StaffOrganisationalRoleType' representing different organisational roles within the staff module of the Fineract system. It includes role constants with associated integer values and string codes, along with methods to access these properties and a static method to obtain an enum instance from an integer value.

classes.name: StaffOrganisationalRoleType
classes.description: An enum representing various staff organisational role types, each associated with an integer value and a string code. Provides methods to retrieve properties and convert from integer values to enum instances.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the role type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the role type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding StaffOrganisationalRoleType enum, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.
